title: Marguerite and the Letter
author: Rosalind Pemberton
blurb: Silas Pemberton, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
